scope: Keep Graph Explorer zoom controls from obscuring interactive map nodes

root_cause.behavior: The floating zoom toolbar covered graph node labels and intercepted clicks when a node occupied the map's upper-right area.
root_cause.cause: The toolbar was absolutely positioned over the SVG without reserving any space in the graph canvas.

change: Move zoom, zoom-out, and reset controls into a labeled group in the map header, outside the interactive SVG canvas.

failure_first.regression: relationship map fits its viewport without horizontal clipping
failure_first.before_fix: The added headed mobile assertion failed because the controls group was absent; the prior real mobile screenshot showed the floating controls over a node label.
failure_first.after_fix: The controls group is present above the canvas on both configured viewport projects.

production_build.command: NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAPH_EXPLORER_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAPH_EVIDENCE_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAPH_RESEARCH_ENABLED=false npm run build
production_build.result: Passed with type validation and 62 generated pages; existing caniuse-lite age and edge-runtime static-generation warnings remain.

jest.result: 214 suites passed, 1 suite skipped; 868 tests passed, 1 skipped.

headed_browser.result: 18 passed and 2 expected feature-off skips across desktop Chromium and iPhone-sized Chromium. The viewport regression checks that the SVG fits its container and the controls sit outside the canvas. Both live FE-to-Monolith cases ran with API interception off.

verification.local_backend: The live local knowledge endpoint returned HTTP 200 with 25 nodes and 5 edges from the isolated legacy seed database.

manual_mobile_browser.browser: Codex in-app Chromium at http://localhost:3200/explore/graph, iPhone-sized viewport
manual_mobile_browser.result: Live search rendered the relationship map; SVG width 356 px, canvas width 356 px, scroll width 356 px, and controls bottom stayed above canvas top. The toolbar no longer obscures graph nodes.
manual_mobile_browser.data_boundary: Isolated local legacy API and Mongo seed; not the accepted hash-pinned graph artifact.

limitations: The live integration uses local legacy seed data; most browser evidence and error-path scenarios use fixtures.
The accepted hash-pinned Leader graph artifact and route are still absent, so this does not establish rights, recommendation calibration, or deployed behavior.
